name: Burn The Heretics boosts damage and healing against targets below 35% health (#708)
contract: Burn The Heretics 560857 is family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with EquippedItemClass -1 and no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE (303) with EffectMiscValue 13 = AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT and EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10; effect 1 is the Ascension-only SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HEALING_DONE_VERSUS_AURASTATE (360), same MiscValue 13, EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10. Unit::Update calls ModifyAuraState(AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT, HealthBelowPct(35)) every tick, so the state tracks health continuously; Unit::SpellPctDamageModsDone (called from SpellDamageBonusDone and MeleeDamageBonusDone) folds aura 303 into DoneTotalMod via victim->HasAuraState(AuraStateType(MiscValue)), and Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone folds aura 360 in the same way. Both are plain native aura types with no missing handler: this is not "no server-side implementation", it already works. The tooltip's second clause ("when Scorch Marks are consumed you now gain 10% increased Magic damage for 8 sec") is not represented anywhere in this spell's two effects, and no spell, aura or module code named 'Scorch Mark(s)' exists anywhere in this repository (module source, core source or SQL) for Sun Cleric or any other class, so that clause has no server mechanism to hook and is not exercised here. This scenario proves only the first, already-correct clause: a fixed base-1000 spell_damage_done/spell_healing_done query against Horusath Blast 500154 and Illumination 500143 (both family 33, no SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS) is unaffected while the target's health is above 35% and gains exactly +10% once it drops below 35%, only for a caster who has learned 560857.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Talent healing matches control above 35% health
Control's damage stays flat below 35% health
Talent gains exactly +10% damage below 35% health
Control's healing stays flat below 35% health
Talent gains exactly +10% healing below 35% health
